story.title: The Good Unicorn
paragraphs_en: Once in the land of unicorns, there was a unicorn who was very good. She loved to go to the magical unicorn park. She liked playing there.
One day with a happy mood as usual she went to the park. To her horror, the toys from the park were missing. She used her magic power to find out what had happened.
She found out that a naughty unicorn had stolen them. She went to him then advised him and made him understand that stealing is not good at all .
He repented his act and apologised to her . They both became good friends.
